clearedSpotChecks.check: Source behind the lifted routines: evm2 State::tstore, rollback and take_transient_storage, StorageSlotHandle::set, call message checkpoints; Tempo's SSTORE override.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I fetched evm2 35aa3280 crates/evm2/src/evm/state/mod.rs and read lines 830-924. tstore returns without a journal entry on an equal write, journals Some(previous) for an occupied slot and removes it on a zero write, and journals None for a vacant slot and skips a zero write. rollback truncates logs and pops entries newest first until the checkpoint length; a TransientStorageChange with a nonzero Some(previous) reinserts it and otherwise removes the key, StorageChange resets the current value. This is EIP-1153 revert semantics. I also fetched hardfork/src/constants.rs: STORAGE_CREDIT_VALUE is SSTORE_CREATE_COST 250,000 minus SSTORE_SET_COST 5,000, so the TIP-1060 part changes gas only, as stated. download.tempo.xyz/binaries/ still lists v1.19.1 as the newest release when I checked. I did not read storage.rs, evm/mod.rs or instructions.rs line by line.
